recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散在數個中型圓形細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少且帶泡狀空泡與不規則邊緣，中央有三顆細胞鬆散成小團，背景有粉紅色細絲狀物質；這些不屬於造血系列的鬆散小圓細胞，需考慮轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Scattered discohesive intermediate-sized round cells plus a small loose group of three cells centrally
Round nuclei with fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale-blue cytoplasm with irregular frayed borders and small cytoplasmic vacuoles/blebs
Faint pink fibrillary strands in the background, possibly neuropil
Occasional residual granulocytic precursors and platelet clumps; camera photograph with grey-tinted red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows scattered discohesive intermediate-sized round cells and a small loose group of three cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and scant, frayed, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. Faint pink fibrillary material is seen in the background, and occasional residual myeloid precursors and platelet clumps are present. Dispersed tumor cells of this type can be mistaken for blasts; the presence of cell groups and fibrillary matrix favors a non-hematopoietic small round blue cell tumor. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma, pending immunophenotypic confirmation (CD45-negative, PHOX2B/synaptophysin-positive).

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are evenly dispersed without cell groups or fibrillary matrix and are CD45-positive by flow cytometry.
Ewing cells also show vacuolated cytoplasm but lack neuropil and are CD99/NKX2.2-positive with EWSR1 rearrangement.
Rhabdomyosarcoma may show vacuolated cytoplasm and multinucleated forms and is desmin/myogenin-positive.
Hematogones are smaller with homogeneous condensed chromatin and scant non-vacuolated cytoplasm, and show a maturing B-cell flow pattern.
